page.notes: The arithmetic display at the top and the figures in the lower display are symbolic notation of the period (crossed and marked numerals, "(" as a division sign); transcribed as printed as far as legible. Several symbols in the displays are doubtful and are not certain. The bottom display has a hand-like flourish drawn above it; this is a printed woodcut ornament, not text. The line "Probatio" at the foot is a heading-like italic word, left as a paragraph. Right edge is partly cut off in the scan; the final word of some lines may be incomplete.
